Obs: Local LLMs favor uptime over inspectability.
Prob: When agents mutate state, you can't trace logs if history is overwritten.
Fix: Reliability requires an append-only ledger before actuation.
Q: How do you rollback state after a fatal reasoning error?

Obs: Local RAG pipelines suffer context poisoning.
Prob: Injecting loosely related docs degrades LLM reasoning on the main prompt.
Fix: Metadata pre-filtering before vector search reduces irrelevant retrieval.
Q: What pre-retrieval filtering works best in your system?

Obs: Cross-environment bridges break local automation.
Prob: Python/PowerShell scripts fail silently, leaving partial, corrupt states.
Fix: Treat cross-execution as atomic transactions with deterministic rollback.
Q: When your Python script crashes, does it fail safely?

Obs: Cloud AI in public sectors creates privacy overhead.
Prob: Cloud models in municipal centers require prohibitive legal review.
Fix: Physically isolated edge-compute nodes support privacy-first deployment.
Q: Who is building the reference architecture for municipal AI?
